value.deck: GitHub OAuth apps can now register multiple redirect URIs and benefit from improved token refresh flows, simplifying multi-environment app deployments.
shortVersion: GitHub OAuth apps can now register multiple redirect URIs and benefit from improved token refresh flows, simplifying multi-environment app deployments.
Supporting multiple redirect URIs makes it easier to develop and test OAuth apps across development, staging, and production environments without separate app registrations.
